title: Domestic kitchen exhaust systems.
officialText:
In all Group R occupancies a minimum of No. 18 Gage galvanized sheet metal shall be used,
except that ductwork that complies with Section 603.6.1.2 shall be permitted for independent apartment exhaust systems providing
general exhaust ventilation of kitchen and toilet areas.
